text: Declarations. Physical damage coverages shown for the covered auto, each subject to the deductible listed: Other Than Collision (comprehensive) deductible and Collision deductible. The deductible is subtracted from each covered loss.
Part D Coverage for Damage to Your Auto. We will pay for direct and accidental loss to your covered auto, minus any applicable deductible shown in the Declarations.
Collision means the upset of your covered auto or its impact with another vehicle or object. We pay for loss caused by collision only if Collision Coverage is shown in the Declarations.

Loss caused by the following is considered other than collision: missiles or falling objects; fire; theft or larceny; explosion or earthquake; windstorm; hail, water or flood; malicious mischief or vandalism; riot or civil commotion; contact with a bird or animal; or breakage of glass. We pay for other than collision loss only if Other Than Collision Coverage is shown in the Declarations.

If breakage of glass is caused by a collision, you may elect to have it considered a loss caused by collision. Windshield cracks and chips from road debris are otherwise paid as other than collision loss.

Exclusions. We do not pay for loss due and confined to wear and tear, freezing, mechanical or electrical breakdown or failure, or road damage to tires; or loss to a vehicle used in any racing or speed contest.
Limit of Liability. Our limit for loss is the lesser of the actual cash value of the stolen or damaged property or the amount necessary to repair or replace it with property of like kind and quality.

Part E Duties After an Accident or Loss. You must give us prompt notice, cooperate in the investigation, submit proof of loss, and allow us to inspect and appraise the damaged property before its repair or disposal.

Definitions. Your covered auto means any vehicle shown in the Declarations, a newly acquired auto, a trailer you own, or a temporary substitute vehicle used while your covered auto is out of normal use because of breakdown, repair, servicing, loss or destruction.

Definitions. A newly acquired auto is a vehicle you become the owner of during the policy period. Collision and Other Than Collision coverage apply to it only if you ask us to insure it within 14 days after you become the owner.

Definitions. A non-owned auto is a private passenger auto, pickup or van not owned by or furnished for the regular use of you or a family member, while it is in your custody or being operated by you, such as a vehicle borrowed from a friend.
Definitions. Family member means a person related to you by blood, marriage or adoption who is a resident of your household, including a ward or foster child.

Part A Liability Coverage. We will pay damages for bodily injury or property damage for which any insured becomes legally responsible because of an auto accident, and we will settle or defend any claim or suit asking for these damages.

Part A Property Damage. Damage you cause to another person's vehicle, fence, mailbox or other property in an accident is paid under liability coverage up to the property damage limit, not under coverage for damage to your auto.

Part A Exclusions. We do not provide liability coverage for any insured who intentionally causes bodily injury or property damage, or for damage to property owned by, rented to or in the care of that insured.

Part B Medical Payments Coverage. We will pay reasonable expenses for necessary medical and funeral services because of bodily injury caused by an accident and sustained by an insured, for services rendered within three years from the date of the accident.

Part C Uninsured Motorists Coverage. We will pay compensatory damages which an insured is legally entitled to recover from the owner or operator of an uninsured motor vehicle because of bodily injury caused by an accident.

Part C Uninsured Motor Vehicle. An uninsured motor vehicle includes a hit-and-run vehicle whose operator or owner cannot be identified and which hits you, a family member, or a vehicle you are occupying.

Uninsured Motorists Property Damage endorsement. Where shown in the Declarations, we pay for damage to your covered auto caused by an identified uninsured driver, subject to a $250 deductible, in place of using your collision deductible.

Transportation Expenses. We will pay, without application of a deductible, up to $20 per day and $600 in total for temporary transportation expenses such as a rental car if your covered auto is stolen or damaged by a covered loss.
For a total theft of your covered auto, transportation expenses begin 48 hours after the theft and end when your covered auto is returned or we pay for its loss.

Towing and Labor Costs. Where shown in the Declarations, we will pay towing and labor costs incurred each time your covered auto is disabled, provided the labor is performed at the place of disablement.

Exclusions. We do not pay for loss to equipment designed for the reproduction of sound or video unless it is permanently installed in your covered auto, nor for loss to tapes, discs, or portable electronic devices left in the vehicle.
Exclusions. We do not pay for loss due to destruction or confiscation by governmental or civil authorities, or for loss due to war, insurrection, nuclear reaction or radioactive contamination.

Exclusions. We do not pay for loss to your covered auto while it is used as a public or livery conveyance, including while logged into a transportation network company app to carry passengers for a fee.

Exclusions. We do not pay for loss to custom furnishings or equipment in a pickup or van, such as special carpeting, murals, paint or decals, height-extending roofs, or customized lighting, beyond the amount shown for custom equipment.

Exclusions. We do not pay for loss to a non-owned auto used by you without a reasonable belief that you are entitled to do so, or while it is maintained or used by a person employed in an auto business.

Payment of Loss. We may pay for loss in money or repair or replace the damaged or stolen property. If we pay for a total loss, the payment is based on actual cash value after deducting depreciation and any salvage value we retain.

An adjustment for depreciation and physical condition will be made in determining actual cash value. If a repair or replacement results in better than like kind or quality, we will not pay for the amount of the betterment.

Appraisal. If we and you do not agree on the amount of loss, either may demand an appraisal. Each party selects an appraiser, the two appraisers select an umpire, and a decision agreed to by any two is binding.
Other Sources of Recovery. If other insurance also covers the loss, we pay only our share. Coverage for a non-owned auto is excess over any other collectible insurance on that vehicle.

Additional Duties for Theft or Hit-and-Run. A person seeking coverage must promptly notify the police if the covered auto or its equipment is stolen, or if an uninsured motorist claim involves a hit-and-run driver.

Additional Duties for Damage to Your Auto. You must take reasonable steps after a loss to protect your covered auto and its equipment from further loss; we will pay reasonable expenses incurred to do so.
A person seeking coverage must submit, as often as we reasonably require, to physical exams by physicians we select and to examination under oath, and must authorize us to obtain medical reports.

Policy Period and Territory. This policy applies only to accidents and losses which occur during the policy period within the United States, its territories or possessions, Puerto Rico, or Canada. Losses in Mexico are not covered.
Fraud. We do not provide coverage for any insured who has made fraudulent statements or engaged in fraudulent conduct in connection with any accident or loss for which coverage is sought.

Termination. You may cancel this policy by returning it or giving advance written notice. We may cancel for nonpayment of premium with 10 days notice, or for other permitted reasons with 20 days notice.

Our Right to Recover Payment. If we make a payment and the person paid has a right to recover damages from another, we are subrogated to that right, and we will seek to recover your deductible from the at-fault party.

Full Glass Coverage endorsement. Where shown in the Declarations, no deductible applies to repair or replacement of the windshield, side or rear windows, or sunroof glass when the loss is covered as other than collision.

Rental Reimbursement endorsement. Where shown in the Declarations, the daily and total transportation expense limits are increased to the amounts shown, and apply while your covered auto is at a repair facility because of a covered loss.

New Car Replacement endorsement. If your covered auto is a total loss within its first two model years, we will pay to replace it with a new auto of the same make and model rather than paying actual cash value.

Loan or Lease Gap endorsement. In a total loss we will also pay the difference between the actual cash value of your covered auto and the amount still owed on its loan or lease, excluding overdue payments and fees.
